I'll rewrite it so each finding is one clean line.A major issue remains. `wait` can return the caller's `ctx.Err()` after `Close` has already finished.

In `blockcache.go`, the first `select` in `wait` returns on `<-ctx.Done()` without reading `c.closed`. A `Get` blocked on an in-flight load can be cancelled and then descheduled. `Close` can set `closed`, join the Loader, drop entries, and return. The waiter then returns `context.Canceled`. That breaks rule 7 (`ErrClosed` beats the caller's context) and rule 8 (every current waiter is woken with `ErrClosed`).

I confirmed it with a synctest probe: cancel the waiter, `synctest.Wait`, then `Close` to completion. The waiter got `context.Canceled` and `Len()` was 0. A 300-trial cancel-and-Close hammer hit the same result on trial 11.

`go test -race` and `go vet` passed on the worktree. The public suite matches the instrument file. Findings are in `code_findings.md`.
